title: Volume as area under the cross-section
caption: Each slice at x is a washer of area π((2x)² − (x²)²) = π(4x² − x⁴). The volume is the area under this graph from 0 to 2, 64π/15 ≈ 13.404.
alt: The curve A(x) = π(4x² − x⁴) rising from 0 to a peak of about 12.6 at x = √2 and falling back to 0 at x = 2, with the area under it shaded.
description: The curves meet at x = 0 and x = 2, with 2x outside.
A slice has area π((2x)² − (x²)²) = π(4x² − x⁴).
V = π∫₀² (4x² − x⁴) dx = π[4x³/3 − x⁵/5]₀².

checks.name: the area under π(4x² − x⁴) from 0 to 2 is 64π/15
